Preface
In early 1996, I taught a course on elliptic curves. Since this was not long after
Wiles had proved Fermat’s Last Theorem and I promised to explain some of the
ideas underlying his proof, the course attracted an unusually large and diverse
audience. As a result, I attempted to make the course accessible to all students
with a knowledge only of the standard first-year graduate courses.
